unix-stream-server-absent.cause: Each case imports run_qualified_android_capture from agent_tools.tests.test_readiness_entrypoints, whose controlled readiness Provider subclasses socketserver.UnixStreamServer. Windows CPython defines no Unix socketserver class.

storage-plan-lock-unsupported.cause: _admit_visual_start now calls _admit_fixture_storage. Its StoragePlans ledger lock refuses non-POSIX hosts with fixture_storage_lock_unsupported, while the cases stub only the resource lock, host system and memory snapshot.

storage-plan-lock-unsupported.fix: skipUnless(os.name == "posix"), the StoragePlans lock gate already used by test_other_owned_provider_growth_blocks_bootstrap_and_start

qmp-peer-af-unix-absent.cause: The harmless QMP peer child binds socket.AF_UNIX, and _qmp_execute plus visual_target.QmpDisk require a Unix-domain peer. Windows CPython has no AF_UNIX.
